donts: Don't present Task Engine, Agent Runtime, or Knowledge Factory as three interchangeable feature cards.
Don't claim customers, benchmarks, scale, or outcomes without evidence.
Don't use amber as a generic accent or teal as ambient neon.
Don't hide the product behind mascots, abstract agent imagery, or generic dashboard mockups.
dos: Do make every major claim inspectable through a diagram, payload, product screenshot, documentation link, or source link.
Do show how authentication and authorization strengthen all three systems.
Do vary section density while preserving one continuous execution story.
Do expose open-source installation and architecture early.
keyCharacteristics: One large operational model before supporting feature detail.
Matte, structured surfaces separated by rules and tonal depth.
Teal carries coordination and action; amber carries identity and signatures.
Real product evidence, data, and source links replace marketing ornament.
narrative.overview: MoltNet should feel like infrastructure a platform team can inspect and operate, not a speculative AI landing page. Its signature composition is a connected system trace: typed work enters, bounded execution occurs, and attributable knowledge survives.

rules.body: Teal explains where work moves. Amber explains who or what authorizes and attests it.
rules.name: The Two-Layer Rule
